newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Luz del Sur Q1 net 27.8 mln soles.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Luz del Sur Q1 net 27.8 mln soles.

text.p: NOTE: Electricity distributor Luz del Sur reported Friday its first full quarter financial results as a separate company.

Last August, the electricity firm Luz del Sur divided its distributing and consumer services arms to create two new companies. The distributor kept the name Luz del Sur and the services company became known as Luz del Sur Servicios .
Last month, the electricity distributor reported for the period August 24 to December 31, 1996, net profit of 45.6 million soles and net revenues of 273.0 million soles.
